episodes.audience: Solo founders, product managers, and technical leads who need a reviewable way to turn customer requirements into implementation plans.
episodes.pain_point: A raw customer requirement is difficult to turn into a reviewable, traceable implementation plan.
episodes.product_proof: Use the real sdtk-spec to SDTK-WIKI Kanban to sdtk-code workflow, showing requirement decomposition and an attended handoff.
source_policy: Use attributable public sources only for general pain-point context.
Use local product evidence only for SDTK behavior and commands.
Record unknowns instead of inferring customer outcomes or performance metrics.
forbidden_claims: No unmeasured productivity, cost-saving, adoption, or customer-result claims.
No claim that an unattended agent makes owner decisions.
required_brief_outputs: A claim ledger with source-backed and forbidden claims.
A shot list that names real product behaviors to capture.
